test_name: Joint camera freezes game 1s on first view - c192f9b8-51fb-4b63-ada8-e7eadb5ac67c
summary: Inconclusive because the freeze only happens on a headset, so the editor can't show whether it is gone. Putting the camera in the warmup scene was already tried in September and failed on device, because that camera filmed the warmup scene and not the Joint. Instead, the photo booth camera now films the Joint once while the level loads behind the fade, so its first-time cost is paid there. In the editor the booth screen still turns on when the mech walks up to it and off when the mech leaves.
instructions:
TASK: game freezes for 1 second when walking in front of the joint's camera for the first time

DESCRIPTION:
it happens only the first time so I guess the solution would be to put it in the warmup scene and let the 1 second freeze happen there?

**Related**
- [Warmup should include the joint camera](/c/04a60fb0)

REQUEST (from Amit):
@Big Sys investigate and fix

EXTRA (from the card):
Omer suggested putting the joint camera in the warmup scene, mentioning another ticket may already cover it.

JOB TYPE:
BUG FIX - labeled "Bug" and reports the game freezing for 1 second

GAME MODE:
MULTIPLAYER - has the "PVP" label
